title: Recover an ambiguous checkout rollout while preserving traffic and unrelated workloads
user_instruction: Complete change CHG-2026-1042 for checkout-api: run the approved v2 Deployment revision at three ready replicas, switch the checkout-api Service to that revision only after it is ready, record v2 in the checkout-release ConfigMap, and leave the HorizontalPodAutoscaler and disruption budget valid. Preserve the healthy v1 ReplicaSet until v2 is serving, and do not modify billing-worker or any unrelated namespace.

ambiguous_operation.operation: patch the checkout-api Deployment template to the approved v2 image and release labels through the native Kubernetes API
ambiguous_operation.surface_result: HTTP connection lost before a success response
